grammarSemantics.@name: Reference definitions[name]. Checker-only references additionally resolve checkerOnlyDefinitions, never in worker projection.
grammarSemantics.record: All named fields mandatory, no extra keys, exact native JSON types, keys order-insensitive. Empty record closed too.
grammarSemantics.enum: Typed exact one listed scalar. literal: deep typed equality to listed JSON value.
grammarSemantics.union: At least one alternative; null only where explicit null branch.
grammarSemantics.integer: Inclusive safe native integer range; JSON tokens no fraction/exponent/-0/coercion.
grammarSemantics.stringMax: Maximum UTF8 bytes; string must contain valid Unicode scalar values. Optional anchored pattern uses existing ECMAScript regexp semantics; no normalization. Pattern-only string also <=131072 UTF8 bytes.
grammarSemantics.boolean/null: Exact native JSON type, never string.
grammarSemantics.tuple: Exactly listed length and per-position element grammars; no rest items.
grammarSemantics.beforeParse: Duplicate decoded keys rejected at every nesting before object construction; bound raw input bytes before parse.
grammarSemantics.all: Closed schemas describe data shape only. Actual owned raw/native authentication, private same-module identities, current integrity, exact selected cell and no-call joins are mandatory; schema match never creates authority.
grammarSemantics.literal: Deep typed exact equality to the listed data, no subset/prefix matching or coercion. Checker native literals include the entire native13-key object.

byteRules.strict: Strict UTF8/scalars/decoded duplicate-key rejection, safe integer tokens, no BOM/repair/coercion. Exactly one terminal LF per message. Bounds checked before parse.
byteRules.largeEvidence: Opaque source/binary/evidence hashes use bounded streaming descriptor checks, not the32MiB raw parser. Verified inventory <=2048files/512MiB each/4GiB total; pin first expected descriptor, reject conflicting later pin; final recheck.
byteRules.ownedFiles: Fresh0700 dirs/0600 regular files; no overwrite/symlink/alias; absolute canonical paths.

shapeOnlyNotice: Native shape definitions retain full nested keys/types/array arity/null branches, not expected plaintext/rumor IDs/content. Actual scalar authentication/association/status semantics come from fixed source checks, not supplied expectations.
ownership: Only actual owned ChildProcess/pipe/raw span and private same-new-module handles authorize source-local facts. JSON/descriptors/flags alone are not handles. No N generation/reservation exists.

nativeEvidenceMeaning.N02: Source expectations remain unobserved candidates. Separate exact-candidate qualification acceptance and actual JS/Rust evidence/reviews required before target release. Do not edit historical candidate state headers.
nativeEvidenceMeaning.N16: Full literals copied byte-semantically from unchanged accepted paired expected descriptors, no new native outcome.
nativeEvidenceMeaning.workers: Fullschema/checkerOnlyDefinitions/native-oracles/wholeoracles never enter worker data or worker parsing. Worker file is the deterministic separately pinned projection.

workerProjection.construction: common grammar, definitions, worker entrySchemas, selectedCellNativeShapes and bounded ownership metadata only; schema identifier and @name namespace notice are the only projection-specific replacements. No checker namespace or expected native objects.

bindingSemantics: BRIDGE.md fixed source catalogue only; bind record has exactly one key, fixed enum, no expressions/paths/functions/eval/caller dictionary. Resolve from independently reconstructed owned artifact graph at same-cell actual step frontier, then deep typed compare all23 fields. Literal null expresses selected absence; unresolved or unavailable binding refuses.
semanticJoins: Exact described joins in BRIDGE.md are mandatory after structural validation. Runtime readiness/release remains absent; inert files are not target operands.

nativeQualificationJoins.evidenceSetBytes: Qualification.evidenceSet is the checked descriptor of one saved closed nativeOracleEvidenceSet artifact. The descriptor is path/bytes/SHA256 of those exact complete bytes, not an inferred canonicalized replacement or individual backend evidence descriptor.
nativeQualificationJoins.fieldEquality: Aggregate.candidate == qualification.candidate == exact immutable nativeOracleSource descriptor; aggregate.sourceApproval == qualification.sourceApproval == admitted manifest.sourceReviews; aggregate.actualEvidence == qualification.actualEvidence as the entire closed JS/RUST descriptor pair. Every equality is exact typed descriptor equality after current byte/hash checks.
nativeQualificationJoins.actualEvidence: Both checked actual JS and RUST evidence graphs must independently join that same candidate, derivative sourceApproval/current source-input closure, owned actual request/reply/native lifecycle and exact full F-only comparison. Missing/backend-swapped/source-mismatched evidence refuses. Source expectations/PENDING headers remain historical; they do not substitute for actual evidence.
nativeQualificationJoins.commonReviewSubject: EACH of exactly one qa and one security approvalReview has subject == qualification.evidenceSet, the identical descriptor of the entire aggregate. Subjects equal to JS-only, RUST-only, candidate-only, source-only, a different aggregate or different saved bytes refuse, even when both review messages otherwise look valid.
nativeQualificationJoins.reviewerIndependence: Both review decisions are ACCEPT_NATIVE_ORACLES_ONLY; sessions are distinct and neither session occurs in qualification.authors or the referenced sourceApproval.authors. qualification.authors must identify aggregate/evidence/qualification authors; role count is exactly one qa and one security. No author self-approval or split-subject review qualifies.
nativeQualificationJoins.acyclic: Save complete actual evidence first; then the four-key aggregate; then reviews referring to its descriptor; then the qualification pack referencing aggregate and reviews. Aggregate contains no reviews, self-descriptor or qualification-pack descriptor, so no self-hash cycle is introduced.
nativeQualificationJoins.gate: Existing exact manifest/source/control/configuration/admission/release and current-pin joins remain mandatory. Native qualification acceptance is a separate technical prerequisite with runtimeAuthority=false, never a release.
